tracking: ADR-0356 (lane E37): the brief is API and backend only; the PM trigger settings, identity-link and trigger list screens are requested on #453 (lane brief rule 3, recorded in ADR-0356)

gaps.GET /v1/pm/connections/:name/trigger-set: reads a PM connection's work-trigger settings (off by default): the agent's PM identities, mechanisms, agent and change attributes
gaps.PUT /v1/pm/connections/:name/trigger-set: saves (and turns on or off) a PM connection's work-trigger settings, validated, audited
gaps.GET /v1/pm/identity-links: lists the admin's PM identity links (PM identity to existing RegulAIt user)
gaps.POST /v1/pm/identity-links: links a PM identity to an existing enabled RegulAIt user (never mints one), audited
gaps.DELETE /v1/pm/identity-links/:linkId: removes a PM identity link; hand-overs from that identity are then denied, audited
gaps.GET /v1/pm/triggers: pages a PM connection's work triggers with their lifecycle state and outcome
